subject: sounds
title: Last sounds
about: Hear a word and pick the letter that makes its last sound. Isolating the final sound is part of NC RF.1.3.c; most first graders find it harder than the first sound, and it comes before the middle vowel, which is harder still.
tip: Say the word, then say just the last sound and ask him to repeat it before tapping.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in bus?
cards.note: bus ends with the s sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in cat?
cards.note: cat ends with the t sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in sun?
cards.note: sun ends with the n sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in dog?
cards.note: dog ends with the g sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in map?
cards.note: map ends with the p sound.

cards.note: bed ends with the d sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in leaf?
cards.note: leaf ends with the f sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in web?
cards.note: web ends with the b sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in gum?
cards.note: gum ends with the m sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in box?
cards.note: box ends with the x sound.

cards.q: Which letter makes the last sound in five?
cards.note: The e at the end of five is quiet. The last sound you hear is v.
